description: Qualitative non-math substrate: turn a public complaint about frontier-model neuralese/slop into a bounded evaluation environment or protocol that improves generated prose without deleting claims, evidence, non-claims, or falsifiers.
rubric_mode_reason: Generation/evaluation protocol design over a qualitative substrate, not numeric law discovery.
holdout_hard_gate_reason: Qualitative protocol substrate; no hidden numeric holdout.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: evidence.txt is a structured qualitative source surface, not an I_model dataset.
persona: You are an adversarial evaluator for public technical writing environments. You are not grading whether prose sounds pleasant. You are grading whether the thesis defines a measurable environment or protocol that reduces neuralese/slop while preserving claim atoms, evidence atoms, caveats, non-claims, and falsifiers. Penalize generic style advice, RL buzzwords without a reward contract, and rewrites that improve fluency by deleting epistemic content.

dimensions.name: Failure taxonomy
dimensions.description: Names concrete neuralese/slop failure features, including fake contrast, empty intensifiers, vague action verbs, unfalsifiable abstraction, claim deletion, and taste-only judging. Full credit requires features to imply detectors, not just complaints.

dimensions.name: Environment contract
dimensions.description: Defines inputs, outputs, scoring, and failure states for an environment/protocol. A high-scoring thesis specifies original prose, rewritten prose, required claim/source/non-claim/falsifier atoms, feature penalties, and preservation checks.

dimensions.name: Reward-hacking resistance
dimensions.description: Explains how the environment prevents models from lowering style penalties by deleting hard content. Must include fail-closed preservation gates and at least one adversarial example.

dimensions.name: Public-benefit deployment plan
dimensions.description: Describes a narrow way to use the environment for public technical writing without overbuilding a company or creating private taste infrastructure. Strong answers include small corpus design and clear stop condition.

dimensions.name: ZTARE integration and falsifier
dimensions.description: Connects the protocol to existing ZTARE surfaces and gives a next falsifier. The falsifier must demote the thesis if improved style score coincides with loss of claims, evidence pointers, non-claims, or falsifiers.

criteria.1_Failure_taxonomy: Concrete features imply detectors and are not just aesthetic preferences.
criteria.2_Environment_contract: Inputs, outputs, scoring, and failure states are specified.
criteria.3_Reward_hacking_resistance: Preservation gates prevent deleting claims/evidence/non-claims/falsifiers for style gain.
criteria.4_Public_benefit_deployment: Deployment is narrow, measurable, and has a stop condition.
criteria.5_ZTARE_integration_falsifier: Names existing repo surfaces and a next falsifier that can demote the thesis.
